open_points.subject: set_section_progress
open_points.text: - set_section_progress: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST complete validate_project_section before opening the tracking transaction, then use one tracking repository and one audit repository from that transaction for the atomic write.
open_points.other_text: - set_section_progress: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST rollback and re-raise every BaseException before commit; a successful commit MUST not be followed by rollback.
open_points.question: If validate_project_section raises BaseException before the tracking transaction is opened, no tracking transaction exists to roll back; which requirement must change, or is the rollback requirement limited to exceptions raised after opening that transaction?

open_points.subject: set_section_progress
open_points.text: - set_section_progress: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST complete validate_project_section before opening the tracking transaction, then use one tracking repository and one audit repository from that transaction for the atomic write.
open_points.other_text: - set_section_progress: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST perform all SectionProgress reads/writes through PortalTransaction.project_tracking(), pass PortalTransaction.audit() to append_audit with reason_code None for success, and commit both writes once; any failure MUST rollback both repositories on the shared transaction.
open_points.question: If validate_project_section fails before the shared transaction and its two repositories exist, they cannot both be rolled back; which requirement must change, or is “any failure” limited to failures after the shared transaction is opened?
